thread:
maria: Heads-up: drafting a concise migration advisory for v1->v2 that focuses on breaking SDK names + model swaps for embeddings. Need quick signoffs.

chet: I'll review the SDK examples. Small ask: include a 1-liner Bash curl example showing both model param names so customers using direct REST can see mapping.

maria: Good idea. Keep it short.

sam: On the JS/TS side, I'll create a tiny compat util and add an inline unit test snippet. Will include deprecation header when env=production.

emily: I'll prepare the external-facing deprecation notice copy. Need 3 bullet points: impact, immediate action, timeline.

maria: Draft timeline: canary Tue, prod rollout Fri. Add a note about SDK patch releases where the shim will be included.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR must include code snippets, migration checklist, and reviewers.

chet: For embeddings: recommend pinning to alias that preserves dims, then fallback code example which attempts `model_compat` on mismatch. Small Python snippet will suffice.

maria: Also highlight vector DB considerations and that reindex might be required if dims change.

sam: Filing PRs now for the SDK shim (#3150) and examples update (#3151).

emily: I'll have the deprecation email copy by EOD.

release-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2026-11-02 09:00 UTC. Prod target: 2026-11-05 03:00 UTC.

maria: Great. Assigning reviewers: @chet, @sam. If anyone needs to attach a sample output (embedding length assertion) add it as a short snippet.

chet: Quick curl example I'll add: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","input":"text"}'
# old param support: {"model_id":"redwood-embed-v2"}
```

maria: Thanks. I'll open the docs PR and list the linked SDK+examples PRs in the description.
